82034.body:
Adrian's DeFi Insights 

Автор: Adrian Pape


Автор: Adrian Pape

    
    
    Прочитайте цю статтю на LinkedIn, щоб приєднатися до обговорення
Прочитати на LinkedIn
https://www.linkedin.com/comm/pulse/level-could-change-my-bitcoin-thesis-adrian-pape-zbece?lipi=urn%3Ali%3Apage%3Aemail_email_series_follow_newsletter_02%3BY64DoPo7RW6aAaUXQwNH4w%3D%3D&midToken=AQFTjFOONAfT2w&midSig=3loupg566Jesw1&trk=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_&trkEmail=eml-email_series_follow_newsletter_02-null-0-read_more_banner_cta_-null-fz96fz~mw4o1xn3~u7-null-null&eid=fz96fz-mw4o1xn3-u7
  
Hey, it's Adrian! Uptober ended in the red for the second year in a row. Bitcoin fell 7.2% in October, and on top of that North Korea drained $6.3 billion from Binance, the biggest hack in crypto history. Not exactly the month the brochure promised. Last week I asked whether crypto would go down if stocks get a proper correction. October answered it: When the AI trade cracked, Bitcoin fell harder than the S&P 500, together with gold and silver. Though look at what happened after the hack. Bitcoin dipped to $76.1k, right into the 50-week moving average I said I expected to hold, and Binance made its users whole within three days. Then the Democrats took both the House and the Senate on Tuesday, and Bitcoin squeezed back above $80k. It didn’t last long. On Thursday the Nasdaq fell about 4% on new AI fears, and Bitcoin went right back down with it. As I write, it sits at $75.9k, exactly on the 50-week moving average again. So does my early bull call need to be revisited? Not yet. It’s being tested a second time this week, and Sunday’s weekly close is the one that counts. In the Alpha section I show you why I keep buying Bitcoin and Strategy, and the AI token on my watchlist where revenue is starting to flow back into the token. Let’s get into the broader picture and how to set up for the coming week: ️ ⚡ On today's Episode: 📈 Macro Update – The Nasdaq fell 5.2% in October and another 4% on Thursday as the AI trade cracked further. Democrats took both chambers, Brent dropped about 13% this week, and December hike odds fell from about 83% to 68%. 🔊 Crypto Pulse – Bitcoin held the 50WMA through a $6.3 billion hack and is back on it at $75.9k after Thursday's selloff. ETFs lost $516 million in October and another $325 million on Thursday, while 102k BTC changed hands into the $66k to $78k range. TAO vs PEARL: subnet revenue above $50 million a year on one side, about 85% supply growth on the other. One question decides which token holds up. 🐂 Alpha Insights – I'm adding Strategy in buy zone 2, and VVV is on my watchlist. The current state of the market. Market Overview Start with the AI trade, because it set the tone for everything else in October. The market finally started to ask how all that AI spending gets financed.
